CREATE TABLE Address(
    [AddressID] INT,
    [AddressLine1] VARCHAR(500),
    [AddressLine2] VARCHAR(500),
    [City] VARCHAR(500),
    [StateProvince] VARCHAR(500),
    [CountryRegion] VARCHAR(500),
    [PostalCode] VARCHAR(7000),
    [rowguid] VARCHAR(600),
    [ModifiedDate] VARCHAR(1000)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN
)

SELECT * FROM Address
